title: Intent-Aware Ctrl+K Command Bar
summary: Find answers, open a page or change reading direction from one keyboard-driven command bar.
interactionSpecs: Ctrl+K or Cmd+K opens the bar. Escape returns focus to the trigger.
Query terms combine domain keywords with an answer, navigation or action intent.
Arrow keys cycle results across groups, and Enter activates the focused result.
codeAlpine: No matching commands.
codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class CommandAskBar extends Component
{
    private const COMMANDS = [
        ['id' => 'solo', 'group' => 'Live answers', 'title' => 'Who built the IT platform?', 'terms' => 'solo ownership system it architecture', 'value' => 'SYS-01 was designed and built end to end by one developer. Its architecture was verified before fleet rollout.'],
        ['id' => 'ratio', 'group' => 'Live answers', 'title' => 'How is the KPI ratio calculated?', 'terms' => 'kpi pooled ratio sites denominator', 'value' => 'Add the reporting sites’ numerators and divide by the sum of their denominators. Count missing denominators separately.'],
        ['id' => 'cv', 'group' => 'Pages', 'title' => 'Interactive CV', 'terms' => 'cv pdf germany relocation', 'value' => '/cv/'],
        ['id' => 'systems', 'group' => 'Pages', 'title' => 'System comparison', 'terms' => 'systems architecture platforms', 'value' => '/systems/'],
        ['id' => 'vault', 'group' => 'Pages', 'title' => 'Component vault', 'terms' => 'components vault patterns', 'value' => '/vault/'],
        ['id' => 'rtl', 'group' => 'Quick actions', 'title' => 'Set right-to-left', 'terms' => 'rtl right to left direction', 'value' => 'rtl'],
        ['id' => 'ltr', 'group' => 'Quick actions', 'title' => 'Set left-to-right', 'terms' => 'ltr left to right direction', 'value' => 'ltr'],
    ];
    public string $query = '';
    #[Locked]
    public string $direction = '';
    public string $message = '';

    private function matches(): array
    {
        $words = preg_split('/[^a-z0-9]+/', strtolower($this->query), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        $intents = ['open'=>'Pages','go'=>'Pages','page'=>'Pages','set'=>'Quick actions','switch'=>'Quick actions','action'=>'Quick actions','who'=>'Live answers','what'=>'Live answers','how'=>'Live answers','answer'=>'Live answers'];
        $group = null;
        $terms = [];
        foreach ($words as $word) {
            if (isset($intents[$word])) $group ??= $intents[$word];
            elseif (!in_array($word, ['the','to','is','a','me'], true)) $terms[] = $word;
        }
        return array_values(array_filter(self::COMMANDS, function ($row) use ($group,$terms) {
            if ($group && $row['group'] !== $group) return false;
            $haystack = strtolower($row['title'] . ' ' . $row['terms']);
            foreach ($terms as $term) if (!str_contains($haystack, $term)) return false;
            return true;
        }));
    }

    public function choose(string $id): void
    {
        foreach ($this->matches() as $row) {
            if ($row['id'] !== $id) continue;
            if ($row['group'] === 'Pages') { $this->redirect($row['value']); return; }
            if ($row['group'] === 'Quick actions') {
                $this->direction = $row['value'];
                $this->message = 'Reading direction: ' . strtoupper($this->direction);
            } else $this->message = $row['value'];
            $this->dispatch('command-picked');
            return;
        }
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.command-ask-bar', ['matches' => $this->matches(), 'groups' => ['Live answers','Pages','Quick actions']]);
    }
}
